additional_info.subject: YNT: ID0414646-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117081] Contactor Error CRM:00921001651
additional_info.body:
Dear Beerpal,
I appreciate your support.
The charger was newly commissioned, and a few days later, we encountered a contactor error. We observed the issue for a while and noted that the location is critical, and the customer saw Socket 1 as "Off". Based on this feedback, I proceeded with an on-site contactor replacement, and after the replacement, the error disappeared.
I understand that the standard procedure is diagnosing the fault before taking action. However, due to the importance of the location and the upcoming 5-day holiday in Turkey, I prioritized ensuring that the charger was fully operational before the holiday period.
Please let me know if you need further details.
